content.title: Special Event Permit for Public Parks
content.summary: This permit is required for hosting events such as community festivals, graduation parties, or large weddings in public parks within the City of Arvada. Applicants must comply with specific rules including event timing, insurance requirements, and waste management plans.
content.eligibility: Anyone planning to hold a special event in a public park in the City of Arvada.

steps.title: Review Special Event Permit Guidelines
steps.text: Read the guidelines for applying for Special Event Permits to understand the requirements and restrictions for events in public parks.

steps.title: Prepare Required Documents
steps.text: Gather all necessary documents including a General Liability Insurance Certificate, a detailed site plan, a waste clean-up plan, and if applicable, a tax exempt number, pavilion receipt, residential street closure permit, vendor list, vendor liability certificates, and alcohol permits.

steps.title: Create a Site Plan
steps.text: Prepare a detailed site map showing event route, start/finish points, registration points, stage and sound equipment placement, food and beverage tents, merchandise tents, signage, first aid sites, parking, generators (not on turf), street closures, special attractions, and electricity requirements.

steps.title: Submit Application
steps.text: Submit the completed application along with all required documents to the City of Arvada for review.

required_documents.name: General Liability Insurance Certificate
required_documents.description: Certificate showing the applicant as insured with a minimum of $1,000,000 each occurrence. The certificate holder and additional insured must be The City of Arvada Risk Management, 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002. Policy coverage must include the event date(s).

required_documents.name: Site Plan
required_documents.description: A detailed map of the event layout including all relevant features such as stages, tents, parking, and street closures.

required_documents.name: Waste Clean-Up Plan
required_documents.description: Plan outlining the types of waste generated, reduction steps such as recycling containers, and disposal methods including temporary dumpsters if needed.

required_documents.name: Tax Exempt Number (if Non-Profit)
required_documents.description: Required if the organization is a 501(c)(3) non-profit. This is not the EIN but the tax exempt number.

required_documents.name: Pavilion Receipt (April through September)
required_documents.description: Receipt for pavilion rental if applicable during April through September.

required_documents.name: Residential Street Closure Permit
required_documents.description: Required if closing a residential street. Must include approval signatures from 80% of affected residents.
required_documents.where_to_get: Request for Revocable Temporary Street Closure Packet (PDF)

required_documents.name: Vendor List
required_documents.description: List of all vendors selling merchandise including business name, address, contact name, phone, and email.

required_documents.name: Vendor Certificate of Liability Coverage
required_documents.description: Proof of vendor liability insurance with minimum coverage amounts depending on vendor type, naming The City of Arvada Risk Management as certificate holder.

required_documents.name: Alcohol Permit
required_documents.description: Required for public events serving alcohol. Must be applied for at least 45 days prior to the event through the City Clerk's Office.

form_fields.label: Event Name
form_fields.description: The official name of your special event.
form_fields.why_needed: To identify the event in the application.

form_fields.label: Event Date(s)
form_fields.description: The date or dates when the event will take place.
form_fields.why_needed: To ensure insurance and permits cover the correct dates.

form_fields.label: Applicant Name
form_fields.description: Name of the person or organization applying for the permit.
form_fields.why_needed: To identify the responsible party for the event.

form_fields.label: Insurance Certificate
form_fields.description: Upload or provide details of the General Liability Insurance Certificate.
form_fields.why_needed: To verify insurance coverage for the event.

form_fields.label: Site Plan
form_fields.description: Upload or provide a detailed map of the event layout.
form_fields.why_needed: To review event setup and ensure compliance with city requirements.

form_fields.label: Waste Clean-Up Plan
form_fields.description: Description or document outlining waste management strategies for the event.
form_fields.why_needed: To ensure environmental responsibility and compliance.

form_fields.label: Vendor List
form_fields.description: List of vendors participating in the event with contact information.
form_fields.why_needed: To manage vendor compliance and tax collection.

form_fields.label: Alcohol Permit
form_fields.description: Indicate if an alcohol permit is required and provide related documentation.
form_fields.why_needed: To regulate alcohol service at the event.

faqs.q: Are bouncy castles allowed at events in public parks?
faqs.a: No, bouncy castles and other inflatable gyms and obstacle courses are prohibited.
No, all events must be over before sundown with no exceptions.

faqs.q: Is alcohol allowed at events in public parks?
faqs.a: Alcohol is only allowed with a proper beer permit during pavilion rental season or a Special Events Permit for public events involving alcohol. Contact the City Clerk's Office for more information.

faqs.q: Do vendors need a business license to participate in special events?
faqs.a: No, vendors participating in a special event are not required to have a business license as they are covered under the special event permit.
